q: In 1945 Hajduk Split toured Egypt, Palestine, Lebanon, Syria and Malta — roughly how many matches did they play?
hint: More than 90 matches on that post-war tour, winning 74 of them — the club was effectively touring as the face of the new Yugoslavia.

q: Which Croatia goalkeeper played for Hajduk Split before joining Monaco and starting the 2018 World Cup final?
hint: Subašić kept goal in Moscow as Croatia lost 4-2 to France. Pletikosa and Gabrić also kept for Hajduk; Livaković came through at Dinamo Zagreb.

q: Who holds Hajduk Split's official appearance record, with 390 matches?
hint: Vedran Rožić made 390 official appearances. Matošić's 739 matches include wartime and friendly fixtures outside the official record.
